audit.summary: Confirmed major: 4 Confirmed minor: 9 Core result refuted: True
limitations: P1 — Proposition 3.17: expected-cost NNCC fails without intermediate integrability — Counterevidence: inf_y c(x,y)=4^x sin^2(pi x) is unbounded, violating3.5. Theorem3.7 and the metric specialization are not refuted by this example. Pointwise cancellation cannot define infinity minus infinity after expectation.

P2 — Lemma 3.3: false graph inclusion in measurable selection — Counterevidence: The same witness has an obvious measurable affine selector; it refutes the printed graph reconstruction, not the lemma's conclusion. A common Lusin set only repairs the separate endpoint-intersection error.

P3 — Example 3.21 fails its global LMP base hypothesis — Counterevidence: Correct failure of those particular lifted curves does not give a counterexample to preservation from a global LMP base. A smooth off-diagonal non-Cartesian locus does not meet the global base claim; the compact converse cannot silently be applied to this singular noncompact cost.

P4 — WFR sphere argument conflates entropy and Euclidean cone costs — Counterevidence: The primary reference distinguishes pi andpi/2 truncations and retains a tip reservoir in its normalization. Existence of suitable common lifts is not attainment for every prescribed lift. This does not disprove correctly defined WFR NNCC; the nonnegative-cosine PSD example avoids this specific obstruction.

P5 — Bi-twist implication and signed quotient in differential preliminaries — Counterevidence: Theorem2.4 independently includes nondegeneracy. Lemma2.5's conclusion follows from t down to0 with arbitrary signed tangent, or the derivative of the comparison gap at its minimum.
P6 — Negative gravity exits the domain in Example 2.11 — Counterevidence: For g>0 the displayed correction to a(s) is nonnegative, preserving the domain and making the cost differences affine.

P7 — Projection remarks omit continuity and common-map requirements — Counterevidence: The algebraic NNCC proposition does not need continuity. A continuous first projection repairs LMP; a common quotient map and the attained lifting equalities give the metric axioms.
P8 — Open-domain support attainment does not follow from compact closure — Counterevidence: Proposition2.36 uses an explicit nonempty-support class and is not refuted.

P9 — Matrix metric normalization, logarithm range and Gaussian completeness — Counterevidence: The corrected log-Euclidean space is Hilbert under log; proper Frobenius quotient proves the intended PSD theorem. Nondegenerate Gaussians are geodesically convex, not complete.

P10 — Right inverse does not exist in singular polar-factor formula — Counterevidence: Choose an orthogonal completion in the polar factorization sqrt(S2)sqrt(Si)=Ui sqrt(sqrt(Si)S2sqrt(Si)); Mi=sqrt(Si)Ui^T has correct covariance and optimal trace alignment.
P11 — Fisher-Rao formula omits Hellinger square — Counterevidence: The subsequent spherical argument applies to arccos(1-H^2/2), with the paper's normalization.
P12 — Partial-transport cone formula has the wrong minimum — Counterevidence: This is a local example formula and does not by itself refute the general conic formulation.
P13 — Procrustes translation bound omits means — Counterevidence: The corrected finite bound together with compact O(n) still supplies the compact parameter set for minimizer existence.
Limitations: The refuted statement is Proposition 3.17 under its printed assumptions; its counterexample does not satisfy (3.5) and does not refute Theorem 3.7.
Limitations: The Lemma 3.3 compact-set graph argument fails, but its conclusion is not disproved by the quadratic-cost witness; a general repaired selection theorem is not supplied.
Limitations: The global negative-log example lacks its asserted base-space LMP. This does not prove that no other LMP non-preservation example exists.
Limitations: The WFR argument conflates entropy and cone costs and arbitrary fixed-lift attainment. Correct WFR/HK nonnegative cross-curvature is not refuted; no replacement proof is claimed.
Limitations: Only exact arXiv v3 was reviewed; equivalence to the journal version is not asserted.
Limitations: Relevant sections of one primary 2018 reference were read; its entire 149-page text and all other cited proofs were not newly audited.
Limitations: No author code was executed. Missing code is not counted as a mathematical defect.
Limitations: UI attribution is the controller's observation; the runtime is GPT-6 Astra Pro, with no independent claim of backend equivalence.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.

proposition.claim:
Recorded check: Proposition 3.17: expected-cost NNCC fails without intermediate integrability

X=Y=R,c(x,y)=4^x sin^2(pi x)+(x-y)^2; discrete atoms p_k=2^-k, T0=k,T1=k+1,Sbar=k. All printed hypotheses and finite endpoint costs0,1 hold.

Recorded check: Lemma 3.3: false graph inclusion in measurable selection

Quadratic cost on R, gamma=delta_(0,2,0),s=1/2,c_n=c,Z_k^1=Z_k^2={(0,0),(2,0)} satisfy all compact-set and convergence prerequisites.

Recorded check: Example 3.21 fails its global LMP base hypothesis

Printed base c=-log|x-y| off diagonal; horizontal endpoints(-1,0),(1,0) and base(-1/2,0) have finite costs.

Recorded check: WFR sphere argument conflates entropy and Euclidean cone costs

KL perspective minimizes at z=sqrt(rs)e^-c/2; sphere antipodes r=s1 permitted.

Recorded check: Bi-twist implication and signed quotient in differential preliminaries

c=x^3y+xy^3 is smooth bi-twisted with convex gradient images; separately c=-x^2y^2,x(s)=s,base0 satisfies Lemma2.5 inequality.

Recorded check: Negative gravity exits the domain in Example 2.11

H=R,g=-1,endpoints(-4,1),(4,1),base(0,1); endpoint costs7.

Recorded check: Projection remarks omit continuity and common-map requirements

Singleton-fiber identity projections into discrete first target; separately P1=id,P2(y)=y+1 with squared Euclidean cost.

Recorded check: Open-domain support attainment does not follow from compact closure

X=Y=(0,1),c=-xy,psi=-x meet the listed smooth assumptions and continuous compact-closure extension.

Recorded check: Matrix metric normalization, logarithm range and Gaussian completeness

Scalar matrices1,e,e^2; logI=0; offdiagonal variation at diag(4,1); variance path(1-t)^2.

Recorded check: Right inverse does not exist in singular polar-factor formula

S2=0,S0=S1=I allowed PSD data.

Recorded check: Fisher-Rao formula omits Hellinger square

Disjoint unit Diracs have H^2=2 and orthogonal square-root densities.

Recorded check: Partial-transport cone formula has the wrong minimum

F(t)=|t-1|,q1,r=s1,d0 allowed.

Recorded check: Procrustes translation bound omits means

mu=nu=delta_a,a!=0,Q=-1,b=2a is optimal.
